text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —What did you just say?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh? Uh, um...?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "You dare... make a fool of this King?"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
How displeasing. Stand up. I shall deal 
with you personally.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
L-Lord Orfe...! That person over there was 
only talking about the race!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Do you wish to be slaughtered as well?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Tch!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Fools, the lot of you... To lecture a king 
is far above your station!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: E-Eeeek...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since returning home from the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe, Orfevre had been in a 
state of wild turbulence. Her fury grew 
more intense with each passing day—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Whoa-whoa-whoaaa!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: A-Are you alright, sir?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oof, ouch, ow. Man, she's got one heck of 
a kick.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Still though... that's crazy stuff. Even 
the great Golshi-chan chickened out.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Don't... come any closer, anyone!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"...So anyway, my bad. Couldn't drag the 
King along."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre turned her back on everything, 
trenching herself in the Trainer's office 
and refusing entry even to those closest 
to her.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Quite a few complaints have reached the 
disciplinary committee as well, saying 
that Orfevre's intensity is terrifying...

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text: L-Lord Orfevre...! How pitiable...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Things have been peaceful lately. In 
the past, I used to see this fire quite 
often.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Everything pisses me off... Giving in to 
the inner urge, destroy, destroy, 
destroy...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Once Orfe gets like this, she won't stop 
until she's burned everything to ashes."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
... However, you do not seem to be in any 
rush.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be... you're confident you can 
soothe Orfe's flames?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching Orfevre these past few days... I 
can tell she feels the humiliation of 
defeat. But that isn't the true cause of 
her anger.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She's definitely carrying something 
heavy. Not because of how it affects those 
around her, but purely for her sake... I 
wanted to know her true feelings."
choice_data_list: I'll face it. As your trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Then I leave it in your hands.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on you, Orfevre's Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The trainer's office was unlocked. I 
timidly stepped into the heavy, oppressive 
darkness—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —I told you... not to come near.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I feel a stinging, tense pressure... 
Still, step by step, little by little... I 
walk toward the sound of Orfevre's voice.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Why?
choice_data_list:
Because I want to know everything you're 
feeling...

Because I want to know everything about 
how you feel...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Don't get cocky.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, she was right in front 
of my eyes. A vivid, brilliant rage burst 
forth from her... —A shiver of sheer 
terror pierced through my entire body.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
It seems they fancy themselves equal to 
the King.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
There is no throne for you. Nowhere at 
all.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
And yet... you want to get closer? You 
want to know?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—There's no way you can touch me. Or would 
you rather be destroyed?!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...What did you say?
choice_data_list:
I'm your cane—I can support whatever 
weight you carry.
I'm your cane — I can shoulder it all.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —I'll test you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre grabbed both of my wrists with all 
her might... and slammed me against the 
wall. The impact made my vision flash—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: What's wrong?! You don't break, do you?!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
If you're just putting on a tough front... 
I'm going to smash through it with 
everything I've got!
choice_data_list:
Bring it! I'll take on—everything you've 
got!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Then!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Whyâweren't you there?!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"How can someone who isn't even here take 
it in?!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: The staff that wasn't in my hand is...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...I shall lead you to the throne.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: As if I'd ever trade places with you!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The more accustomed I become, the more the 
time we've spent together...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
With every day that passed, our 
synchronized breaths grew stronger!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: As if anyone could take her place...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...I'm so mad.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...No matter how much devotion they show. 
Even if I am worshiped by the masses..."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "Alone."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I was...—all alone.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Unable to even see a guiding light.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
choice_data_list: I didn't understand anything at all.
I didn't understand a single thing.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Too slow.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Too slow...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even under her direct gaze, fear no longer 
lingers. All that remains before her... is 
pure resolve.
choice_data_list: I swear I'll never leave you alone again.

I swear, I will never leave you alone 
again.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: How will you prove your sincerity?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My wrists, gripped tightly by Orfevre... I 
squeezed down hard over them, as if to 
sear that pain into my memory for the rest 
of my life.
choice_data_list:
I'll keep feeling your flame right there 
with you.

I'll keep feeling your flame right there 
with you

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...That heart.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Never, ever forget that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Orfevre's anger subsiding, we decided 
to review the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, 
which we hadn't been able to do yet.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe was 
incomprehensible.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I tried to accelerate just like that... 
However...
choice_data_list:
As if guided by something, towards the 
inner rail...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since then, I watched the footage over and 
over again. But no matter how many times I 
watch it, I can't understand why she lost. 
It truly was an inexplicable defeat.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...You felt it as well, did you? Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The cause is entirely unknown. ...Which 
makes it all the more infuriating.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An inexplicable cause for defeat must have 
also added fuel to her anger. Smart as she 
is, if she knew the reason, she wouldn't 
have been this upset.
choice_data_list:
We have to figure out the cause by next 
year.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Next year?
choice_data_list:
You're going to win back your crown, 
right?
We'll take back your crown, won't we?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...That's right.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. I will not let things end... 
like this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now that we had reached an agreement, 
there was one more thing we needed to 
confirm. And that was our next target: the 
"Japan Cup"...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Isn't it obvious?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "I remain weary. A diversion is in order."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I'll go on a little rampage. —I just hope 
someone out there is sturdier than you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Heading into a race right after a grueling 
overseas expedition without sufficient 
rest... But I cannot let anything cloud 
her future.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —That night, I had another... dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Orfevre is defeated by the strongest 
Triple Tiara Umamusume. ...The dream of 
the Japan Cup."
